span.p: 1 Owner design intent expressed in the Chief chat

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 2 Chief records the requirement and prepares a concise proposed packet request - COS-CEO-N-nnn, READY_FOR_CEO_REVIEW

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Owner hop - activate CEO chat

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 3 CEO validates priority and authority fit, checks conflict with existing directives and project authority

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Architect review only if CEO detects a structural or authority conflict

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: CEO writes CEO-OPS-nnn to Delivery From-CEO, status OPEN

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Owner hop - activate Delivery chat

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 4 Delivery verifies live state, duplicates, canonical destination and whether the packet is still appropriate - evidence order 1 to 4

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: NOT_READY / BLOCKED - destination or a required field ambiguous, no send-ready Owner task

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 5 store the final packet durably with stable ID and source pointers - VERIFIED / READY_FOR_OWNER_DELIVERY

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Response-To CEO-OPS-nnn COMPLETE, READY_FOR_CHIEF_RENDERING, NEEDS_OWNER_PING 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Owner hop - return to Chief with the DONE_EVENT

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Chief renders one packet - platform plus exact chat name, and model plus effort for coding agents

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Delegation evidence present - originating authority, stable ID, bounded scope, return or acceptance path

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ROUTING_STATE = BYPASS_SUSPECTED - block consequential writes, read-only evidence only, route back to canonical authority

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 6 Owner hop - send the validated packet once to the worker

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: SENT_EVENT bound - DELIVERED / DELEGATED_IN_FLIGHT, duplicates suppressed, No-Idle rescan

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: worker executes bounded scope and writes durable recipient evidence - handoff, Status, Response-To

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Owner hop - report completion, or Chief reads durable evidence on next activation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: DONE_EVENT bound - reconcile Response-To, project and runtime evidence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: COMPLETED / RECONCILED - closure evidence preserved, lane leaves live set

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: PARTIAL - remaining step inside packet scope, no new CEO or Delivery approval needed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Owner hop - in-scope remediation instruction, no new approval - OBSERVED PRACTICE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: immediate No-Idle rescan - next stage becomes a new COS-CEO-N item, not a reuse of the terminal packet
